newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal PM sees 1996 budget deficit 4 pct GDP.
newsitem.headline: Portugal PM sees 1996 budget deficit 4 pct GDP.

text.p: Prime Minister Antonio Guterres said Portugal's budget deficit would stand at 4.0 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) in 1996, below an earlier forecast of 4.2 percent.

Speaking at celebrations to mark the 150th anniversary of the Bank of Portugal, he added that the Socialist government would present its supplementary budget for 1996 at the next cabinet meeting on Thursday.

"I can announce that the supplementary budget (for 1996) will go to the cabinet meeting on Thursday. It will confirm forecasts for a budget deficit around 4.0 percent (of GDP)," Guterres told reporters.
